_readme: People whose Telegram mentions MAKIMA should tag in alerts. This is NOT the admin list - ADMIN_USER_IDS controls who can use the bot. Add someone here only if a mention of them in a watched group should raise a tagged alert. Each entry needs a 'tag' plus a 'user_id' and/or a 'username'. Matching is exact: a literal @username on a word boundary, or a Telegram text-mention carrying the numeric user id. Plain names in ordinary text never match. Send /reload to the bot after editing this file - no restart needed.
